sampling: Native pixel centers to 30 km; actual highest source pixel per 4x4 block from 30 to 150 km. Source sample coordinates retained.
limitations: Terrain beyond 150 km is not modeled.
80 m source resolution can omit narrower ridges.
Peak selection in 320 m far blocks does not preserve every sub-block azimuth.
DEM effective resolution and errors vary; pixel spacing is not an accuracy guarantee.
